## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. For device/browser work, include the OS, transport and tested flow without device identifiers. State what remains untested.

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Tests cover any changed protocol or security boundary.
- [ ] No signing credentials, device data, raw authentication messages or generated binaries are included.
